name: What information do I need before getting a flooring quote for a foreclosed property?

mainEntity.name: What information do I need before getting a flooring quote for a foreclosed property?

acceptedAnswer.text: The most useful evidence is clear photos of every damaged area, notes about odors or leaks, and any known history of water intrusion or vacancy. If you want a reliable quote, a contractor should also see the property in person because foreclosed homes often hide subfloor and moisture problems.
acceptedAnswer.description: Bring photos, room measurements, and notes about leaks, odors, or visible damage. A site visit is still important because foreclosed homes often have hidden issues.
